incidents.title: API Gateway — P99 latency spike >8s on /checkout endpoint
incidents.root_cause: Deadlock in connection pool under high concurrency — 3 threads waiting on same DB connection
incidents.customer_impact: ~2,400 users experienced checkout failures. Revenue impact estimated $18K.
incidents.resolution: Increased connection pool size from 20 to 50. Added connection timeout of 3s to prevent deadlock.
action_items: Add connection pool saturation alert (marcus.lee — due 2024-01-16)
Load test checkout at 2x peak traffic (david.kim — due 2024-01-23)
Review all services for similar connection pool sizing (arjun.mehta — due 2024-01-20)

incidents.title: Auth service — token validation returning 500 for 12% of requests
incidents.root_cause: Bad deploy — JWT library version bump introduced breaking change in RS256 key parsing
incidents.customer_impact: ~800 users unable to log in. SSO-dependent services degraded.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back auth-service to v2.14.1. Pinned JWT library version.
action_items: Add JWT library to dependency review checklist (arjun.mehta — due 2024-01-22)
Implement canary deploy for auth service (emily.zhang — due 2024-02-15)

incidents.title: Payments service — intermittent 503s from downstream Stripe API
incidents.root_cause: No retry logic on Stripe API calls — single timeout treated as hard failure
incidents.customer_impact: ~320 payment failures. All retried successfully by users within 10 minutes.
incidents.resolution: Temporary: increased Stripe API timeout from 5s to 15s. Permanent: retry with backoff (PLAT-1054).
action_items: Implement retry with exponential backoff for all payment API calls (arjun.mehta — PLAT-1054)
Add circuit breaker for Stripe (arjun.mehta — PLAT-1050)

incidents.title: Grafana + Prometheus — monitoring stack down, no visibility for 40min
incidents.root_cause: Prometheus OOM killed after scraping a misconfigured high-cardinality metric endpoint
incidents.customer_impact: No customer impact. Internal visibility lost for 40 minutes.
incidents.resolution: Restarted Prometheus with memory limits. Identified and dropped high-cardinality metric.
action_items: Add cardinality guardrails to metric ingestion (marcus.lee — due 2024-02-08)
Set Prometheus memory limits and alerts (marcus.lee — due 2024-02-06)

incidents.title: Full platform outage — DB primary failover stuck, replica not promoted
incidents.root_cause: Patroni misconfiguration: replica promotion timeout too aggressive (10s). Under network partition, replica aborted promotion before completing. Manual intervention required.
incidents.customer_impact: Complete platform outage 1:55 AM – 5:30 AM. ~14,200 users affected. Estimated revenue impact $210K.
incidents.resolution: Manual Patroni failover executed by marcus.lee. Increased promotion timeout to 60s. Added pre-promotion health checks.
action_items: Fix Patroni promotion timeout config (marcus.lee — completed 2024-02-10)
DR runbook for manual DB failover (marcus.lee — due 2024-02-20)
Chaos engineering: simulate network partition monthly (david.kim — due 2024-03-01)
Automated failover testing in staging (david.kim — due 2024-03-15)
Improve oncall escalation for P0s — page all seniors immediately (sarah.chen — policy updated 2024-02-12)

incidents.title: Memory leak in API gateway causing OOM restarts every ~6 hours
incidents.root_cause: Unclosed GZIPOutputStream on compressed responses — ~2KB leaked per request. Fix shipped in PLAT-1047.
incidents.customer_impact: Intermittent 30s degradation windows every ~6 hours during pod restart cycles.
incidents.resolution: Deployed fix from PLAT-1047. Validated stable memory under 30-min load test.
action_items: Add heap memory alert at 80% threshold (marcus.lee — completed)
Code review checklist: stream resource cleanup (arjun.mehta — due 2024-02-22)

incidents.title: Notification service — emails delayed 4–6 hours, queue backed up
incidents.root_cause: SQS consumer thread pool exhausted — max_workers set to 2, insufficient for queue depth spike after marketing campaign
incidents.customer_impact: ~5,400 transactional emails delayed. No emails lost.
incidents.resolution: Increased consumer thread pool to 20. Drained backlog in 35 minutes.
action_items: Auto-scale SQS consumer based on queue depth (emily.zhang — due 2024-03-20)
Alert on SQS queue depth > 1000 messages (marcus.lee — completed)

incidents.title: Auth service — elevated 401s after secret rotation (misconfigured new key)
incidents.root_cause: Secret rotation script (PLAT-1045) completed successfully but auth service config reload was not triggered. Service continued using expired key.
incidents.customer_impact: ~1,100 users received 401 errors for 43 minutes. Re-login resolved issue.
incidents.resolution: Manually triggered config reload on auth service. Auth service now reads secrets dynamically via Vault agent — no reload needed going forward.
action_items: Automate config reload after secret rotation (arjun.mehta — due 2024-03-13)
Add post-rotation smoke test to secret rotation runbook (marcus.lee — due 2024-03-10)

recurring_themes: Missing retry/resilience logic on external calls
Operational errors following manual processes (secret rotation, config reloads)
After-hours DB and infra incidents concentrated on marcus.lee
